'''Nalto''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A subordinate of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ardmore]], Nalto was tasked with reestablishing communication with Lieutenant [[Torsin]]'s unit after the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] went missing in the [[Gorinth Agricultural Sector]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nalto appears in hologram form in conversations for the mission "Salting the Fields" for Imperial players in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
